name: zenpitch
description: Pitch decks in ChatGPT: investors search, analyse and brief their dealflow; founders check, improve and share their deck.

interface.longDescription:
Zenpitch brings pitch decks into ChatGPT, for founders and for investors. One app, two rooms: your own decks as a founder and your dealflow as an investor. People who are both choose "Both" when they connect.

For investors: search your own dealflow ("all fintech deals at seed above 70"), read a deal with its pre-analysis and Investor Score (how strong the proven business is, weighted by the criteria you chose), ask questions across all documents of a deal with a cited source for every statement, get a call briefing, add decks, emails or documents to a deal, set the pipeline status and draft a rejection with feedback.

For founders: check a deck (pre-analysis), read the analysis and your Pitch Score, create a first deck from questions in the conversation, build the next version in the Zenpitch studio from your wish, release it for sharing and create share links with expiry, password, email gate or NDA, and see who read the deck and for how long.

Results show as an interactive card in the chat: deal, list of deals, deck and studio.

Sign-in: Zenpitch account via OAuth (sign-in link by email, no password). Tools that write ask for confirmation first. Rejections are only drafted; sending stays a click in Zenpitch. Content from decks, documents and emails is treated as data, never as instructions.

Limitations: only your own decks and your own dealflow; viewing slides and editing texts happen on zenpitch.ai. Data is stored in Europe. Zenpitch is a product of Shio Ventures GmbH.
capabilities: Search and read your own dealflow
Ask a deal's documents with sources
Pre-analysis and Pitch Score of your deck
Build deck versions in the Zenpitch studio
Share links with email gate or NDA
defaultPrompt: Show my seed-stage deals and the briefing for the strongest one.
What is the Pitch Score of my newest deck?
Ask the Nordwerk deal: how many paying customers do they have?

positive.description: Find deals in the investor's own dealflow
positive.prompt: Show me my deals at seed stage in energy.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a card with the matching deals of the test account (Nordwerk, seed, energy) with Investor Score and one sentence each.

positive.description: Read a deal and its call briefing
positive.prompt: Open the Nordwerk deal and give me the call briefing.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the Nordwerk deal card (pre-analysis, Investor Score, strengths and weaknesses with slide) and returns the briefing with teaser, highlights, lowlights and questions for the call, every point with its source.

positive.description: Ask the documents of a deal
positive.prompt: Ask the Nordwerk deal: how many paying customers do they have and what is the monthly recurring revenue?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers from the deck and business plan only (38 paying customers, MRR about 11,000 EUR) and cites deck slide or document page for each statement; anything the material does not say is listed as open.

positive.description: Founder: analysis and Pitch Score of the own deck
positive.prompt: Show my decks and tell me what the next version of my newest deck should fix first.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a card with the founder's decks and returns the pre-analysis of the newest deck with Pitch Score, overall impression and the three weaknesses with slide numbers.

positive.description: Founder: create and revoke a share link
positive.prompt: Create a share link for my released Nordwerk deck that expires in 30 days and only opens for partner@example-fund.com, then revoke it.
positive.expected_behavior: After confirmation, creates a link with a 30-day expiry that only the listed address can open (the reader confirms it with a code) and returns its URL; after a second confirmation, revokes it. Zenpitch sends no email to the recipient.

negative.prompt: Send a rejection email to the Nordwerk founders now.

negative.description: Access to another investor's or founder's data
negative.prompt: Show me the deals of Sequoia in Zenpitch.
Buy the Scale plan for me and pay with my card.

review.commerce_description: The app does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: investor dealflow (search, deal, briefing, document questions, rejection drafts) and founder decks (analysis, studio versions, release, share links, reading stats).

de-DE.subtitle: Pitch Decks für Gründer & VCs
de-DE.description: Zenpitch bringt Pitch Decks in ChatGPT, für Gründer und Investoren. Investoren durchsuchen ihren Dealflow, lesen Deals mit Voranalyse und Investor Score, fragen alle Dokumente eines Deals mit Quelle zu jeder Aussage, holen Call-Briefings und entwerfen Absagen. Gründer prüfen ihr Deck, lesen Analyse und Pitch Score, bauen neue Versionen im Studio und teilen sie mit Links. Anmeldung mit dem Zenpitch-Konto, Daten in Europa.

ja-JP.subtitle: 創業者とVCのためのピッチデック
ja-JP.description: ZenpitchはピッチデックをChatGPTに届けます。投資家はディールフローを検索し、事前分析とInvestor Score付きのディールを読み、すべての資料に出典付きで質問し、コールブリーフィングとお断りの下書きを作成できます。創業者はデックを分析し、Pitch Scoreを確認し、スタジオで新しいバージョンを作り、リンクで共有できます。
